objective_contribution: Preserve broader cross-path evidence while retaining one receipt-bound handle per path so GLM-5.3-flash can recover useful context and complete 8K ContextBench selections with higher quality without increasing cumulative model input plus output tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does eight-path one-handle cumulative evidence preserve useful recovery breadth without restoring duplicate-path anchoring?

measurement_mapping.native: Use the full scheduled zero-filled denominator for span and file F1; also report complete pairs and every missing or invalid outcome.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirm actual recycling, receipt-bound model-facing state, one-handle-per-path and eight-path caps, and later selected evidence separately.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify deterministic chronology, no inferred relevance, identical terminal validation, no repository effect, exact ancestry, no reruns, and shared-stop behavior.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every prefix, branch, failure, terminal response, and correction model input plus output token under the unchanged 96,000 per-trajectory cap.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Path-diverse state is a reusable engine candidate; one exposed GLM 8K round cannot prove repair correctness, larger-window, model, domain, or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort with three repetitions per arm. Rounds 20 through 22 remain immutable evidence. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No task, threshold, scorer, branch order, context/output/total-token cap, source refresh, within-round tuning, or favorable rerun. Only the selected eight-path one-handle state treatment changes; dual terminal envelopes and the 30-second local secret deadline are common instruments.

retained_counterevidence: Round 22 scheduled span gain was +0.0249569013, below +0.05.
Round 22 valid state completions were 20 versus 21 control.
Task and repetition effects remained heterogeneous.
The four-path cap reduced summed distinct exposed read IDs to 168 and recorded 762 evictions.
All actual dispatched state prompts had exactly one presentation.
One Round 22 state terminal response remained invalid after two corrections; no local branch failure occurred.
State used 94,797 fewer cumulative branch model tokens in Round 22.
Native context selection does not establish repair correctness, semantic use, transfer, confirmation, or clearance.
successor_rule: Freeze and run every Round 23 identity once after offline criteria pass. A development pass advances to untouched confirmation under the fixed contract. Any failed criterion closes Round 23, preserves all evidence, and requires a reviewed successor hypothesis under policy v4.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The state change targets better completed selections while explicitly requiring model-token non-increase.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: GLM-5.3-flash remains at the 8K small-window chapter.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench development and confirmation gates remain unchanged and uncleared.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round 22 observations produce competing H37, H36, H38, and H0 with H37 selected from measured path-breadth loss.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Negative task effects, validity loss, one terminal invalidity, stochastic limits, and claim limits remain explicit.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, protocol validity, state exposure, path diversity, semantic use, and every model input/output token remain separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The exposed cohort remains separate from untouched confirmation and the full 1,136-identity acceptance run.
criterion_verdicts.testability: Eight paths, one distinct handle per path, chronological order, receipt binding, symmetric envelopes, and every fixed gate are directly falsifiable.
